resources.string: Paused time stays paused when returning from Location management, the Observatory and other pages.
Antipodes inherit their source point symbols: rise, set, maximum, minimum and ordinary points.
Antipodes of the current position use the object thumbnail, including the Moon’s phase.
More compact bubbles show the object and point name with an antipode symbol in views, captures and panoramas.
CSV and readable tables identify each antipode with the object and original point names.
Returning from Location editing preserves the paused moment and the configured forward or reverse playback speed.
